text.title: 心脏旁的箭头
text.situation:
下一张桌上，彩色箭头带访客看心脏模型周围的血流。一条动脉标为把血液带离心脏的血管，一条静脉把血液送回心脏。萨姆问讲解员，颜色是否真是身体的一部分。她解释，那是图示的配色选择。心血管展示把心脏和血管一起呈现，较小的心脏模型只重点展示心脏。

访客：另一边手臂模型上的细线是什么？
讲解员：它代表神经，是传递信号的纤维束。
访客：旁边的卡片属于同一系统吗？
讲解员：那张卡介绍免疫系统，它帮助身体抵御有害生物和物质。这里有不同系统的卡片，虽然系统会共同工作。

paragraphs.en: At the next table, coloured arrows led visitors around a model heart. An artery was labelled as a vessel carrying blood away from the heart; a vein carried blood back towards it. Sam asked the guide whether the colours were part of the real body. She explained that they were choices in the diagram. The cardiovascular display showed the heart and blood vessels together, while a smaller cardiac model focused on the heart alone.

paragraphs.en:
Visitor: What is the thin line on the separate arm model?
Guide: It represents a nerve, a bundle of fibres carrying signals.
Visitor: Does the card beside it belong to the same system?
Guide: That card is about the immune system, which helps defend the body against harmful organisms and substances. We have different system cards here, even though the systems work together.

S10.E04.P01.cue: 解释箭头展示的两个方向。
acceptableAnswers: 动脉把血液带离心脏，静脉把血液送回心脏。
心血管展示包括血管。心脏模型重点展示心脏。

S10.E04.P03.cue: 描述手臂上的线和另一张卡片。
acceptableAnswers: 线代表神经。另一张卡片解释免疫系统。

S10.E04.T01.cue: 描述一张只展示心脏的图。
acceptableAnswers: 这张心脏图重点展示心脏。
